svg.aria-label: Abstract animation of the idea behind Pneuma. A sealed app with fixed feature cells opens; the cells come loose and re-form as a capability graph. An agent trace (ember) runs through the graph and marks each node it touches; a person (sand) steps in at one node and bends the path, and what they wanted settles as a layer of preferences along the base. The change passes a gate, then the graph forks into differently shaped variants that carry the preferences with them. Captions: features → capabilities, black box → open loop, app → fork.
svg.title: Pneuma, the idea
